title: Abal fazl
body:
Abal fazl
Abbas..
Abal fazl, abal fazl..(4)
<<MINI>>
{Abal fazl e bawafa, alamdaar e lashkaram
Mahe haashmi nasab, ameer e dilawaram}..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khuda ke dee'n ka paasbaa'n
shuja'ato ka aasmaa'n
jalaal tera al amaa'n.. abal fazl..(2)
Husainiyat ka tarjumaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ghum zado'n ka sayebaa'n
alam ba dosh e rehnumaa.. abal fazl..(2)
2. Ye murtaza ka gul badan
weqaar e haideri chaman
<<DIVIDER>>
shuja'ato ki anjuman.. abal fazl..(2)
ali misaal tegh zan
wohi sukhan wohi chalan
ali e dashte karbala.. abal fazl..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ameer e sabr ka akhi
qaraar e jaane zainabi
amme sakina hai yahi.. abal fazl..(2)
tujhko shahadat jo mili
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoolegi duniya na kabhi
tera alam u'ncha raha.. abal fazl..(2)
4.  Aye noor e dil mara qamar
aye roshni mara sahar
<<DIVIDER>>
ba waqt e ghum mara separ.. abal fazl..(2)
tere hai sab ye behrobar
tu hi duao me asar
tere sabab hu bekhatar.. abal fazl..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ghulam e ibne murtaza
rehan o sarwar e azaa
hamara marqaz e wafa.. abal fazl..(2)
dua e binte fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
jaha'n alam ye jab utha
falak pukara marhaba.. abal fazl..(2)
<<MINI>>
{Abal fazl e bawafa, alamdaar e lashkaram
Mahe haashmi nasab, ameer e dilawaram}..(3)
